items.question: How quickly will I see results?
items.answer: Most orders start processing within 1-6 hours and complete within 24-72 hours depending on the service and quantity. Some services like Instagram likes can start immediately.

items.question: Are the followers/likes real?
items.answer: Yes, we provide high-quality engagement from real, active accounts. We never use bots or fake profiles. All our services comply with platform guidelines.

items.question: Is it safe for my account?
items.answer: Our services comply with all platform guidelines and we use gradual delivery methods to ensure account safety. We've been in business for years with zero account bans.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept various payment methods including PayPal, credit cards, cryptocurrency, and local payment methods for your convenience.

items.question: Do you offer refunds?
items.answer: Yes, we offer refunds for undelivered orders or if you're not satisfied with the quality. Please contact our support team within 30 days of your order.

items.question: Can I track my order progress?
items.answer: Yes! You can track all your orders in real-time through your dashboard. You'll also receive email notifications about order status updates.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.introduction: Welcome to OriginalSMM.uz. These Terms of Service ('Terms') govern your use of our website and services. By accessing or using our site, you agree to be bound by these Terms.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By using our services, you confirm that you accept these Terms and agree to comply with them. If you do not agree, you must not use our services.

services.title: Our Services
services.content: OriginalSMM provides social media marketing services, including but not limited to delivering real followers, likes, views, and engagement on platforms like Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and Facebook. Services are provided 'as is' without warranties.

userObligations.title: User Obligations
userObligations.content: You must provide accurate information, not misuse the site, and comply with all laws. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account.

payments.title: Payments
payments.content: We accept payments via Payme, Click, and Payeer. All payments are final and non-refundable unless specified otherwise. You agree to pay all fees associated with your purchases.

refunds.title: Refunds and Cancellations

intellectualProperty.content: All content on the site is owned by OriginalSMM. You may not reproduce or distribute it without permission.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.content: We do not guarantee results from social media platforms' algorithms. Services may be affected by platform changes.

limitationOfLiability.title: Limitation of Liability
limitationOfLiability.content: OriginalSMM shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our services.

termination.title: Termination

changes.title: Changes to Terms

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: At OriginalSMM, we respect your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.

informationWeCollect.title: Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.content: We collect personal information such as email, payment details, and usage data when you register or make purchases.

howWeUseInformation.title: How We Use Your Information
howWeUseInformation.content: We use your information to provide services, process payments, and improve our site. We may send promotional emails.

sharingInformation.title: Sharing Your Information
sharingInformation.content: We share information with payment processors (Payme, Click, Payeer) and service providers. We do not sell your data.

security.title: Security
security.content: We use encryption and secure servers to protect your data, but no system is completely secure.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.content: You can access, update, or delete your information by contacting us. You may opt-out of marketing communications.

childrenPrivacy.title: Children's Privacy
childrenPrivacy.content: Our services are not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children.

internationalTransfers.title: International Data Transfers
internationalTransfers.content: Your data may be transferred to servers outside Uzbekistan, subject to adequate protections.

changes.title: Changes to Privacy Policy
